affected_subject.reason: Identifies WERC7575Vault.withdraw/redeem and _withdraw helper as affected functions.

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete trigger: any address calls withdraw/redeem for an owner who has issued the self-allowance permit.

direct_effect.reason: Burns owner's shares and transfers underlying assets to arbitrary receiver, leaving victim with zero.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Authorization relation: NatSpec requires msg.sender be owner or approved, but code lacks the check.

summary: Report identifies affected withdraw/redeem functions, the unauthorized-caller trigger, share-burn/asset-theft effect, and an authorization expectation contradicted by code, sufficient to attempt P/I/V formalization.
